surfaces.note: HTTP and SDK capture are not implemented in corpusctl.
HTTP/SSE transport is outside WS NDJSON; package integration tests remain authoritative.
Auth lifecycle is HTTP; WS refresh-token initialization fixture is not yet authored.
Pre-init and missing/malformed operation input errors.
Anonymous initialization with exact attrs/auth/status envelopes.
Re-init detaches previous query registration.
Old SDK initialization still includes attributes.
Dynamic data-dependent view rules are explicitly excluded; runtime paths reject them before protected rows are fetched or returned.
Seeded records are hidden by a closed view rule.
Closed update rule rejects a mutation.
Admin-authenticated aggregate count over two seeded entities.
Empty posts node-list result.
Seeded nonempty equality filter selects the matching entity.
Duplicate subscription, removal, re-add.
Two seeded limit/offset pages, exact emitted cursors and next/previous boundary flags; no cursor advancement claim.
Reusing the emitted first-page cursor returns the second entity; promoted unchanged desired outputs from the former known-gap fixture.
Aliased cardinality-one forward relation retains reference and child projection; not full relation/permission parity.
v2 delta path is package-tested; no v1 parity claim.
Subscribed query receives full result after commit.
Missing room errors, empty resync, leave; not peer fanout.
No cross-node ephemeral-state bus.
Multi-session peer fanout/dynamic session-key snapshots need an explicit multi-client capture contract.
Acknowledgement-only start/remove-sync and stream handlers are not implemented features.
In-band add-attr preserves existing schema identity.
Concrete persisted title write.
Deep merge, full cardinality/cascade matrix and missing-entity lookup variants remain package-test evidence only.
Unique entity lookup updates the existing concrete entity.
Integer above 2^53 survives write, storage, query, and node-list projection.
Required-field retraction fails and leaves exact original data.
Persisted triple removal followed by empty query.
Unknown attribute rejects multi-step transaction without a partial write.

coverage.note: Covered by checked-in raw capture transactions-rollback-error.json (baseline query exact one-entity state, failing low-level two-step batch with exact 400 carrying the stable unique-constraint marker, post-rollback query byte-identical to baseline proving no partial write, cardinality query exact final-value, merge query exact preservation, deleted query exact empty set) replayed exactly by cmd/instantd/runtime_cf003_rollback_replay_test.go::TestCF003RollbackCaptureReplay on the owned isolated transactions-rollback-error fixture (app 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003); the four mutating transact successes run live (tx-id watermarks and X-admin-token never checked in) with strictly advancing tx-ids, the run-minted attr UUIDs in the failing request stay sentinel-masked by the stated rule with live substitution counts and no-leak asserts, and whole-result DeepEqual lengths-before-elements guards every state. The timing-dependent same-lookup concurrent leg is excluded with reason (start barrier encourages but does not force DB overlap; assembled 10x-race proof is boundary evidence only); cardinality/merge/delete legs are boundary evidence for the neighboring transactions-cardinality-boundary and transactions-lookup-lifecycle rows (transactions-lookup-lifecycle now covered by its own 2A-7 capture), as does transactions-concurrency-gap which stays gap. coverage.note: Covered by checked-in raw SSE capture transactions-cardinality-boundary.json (one single-subscriber connect with exact status/Content-Type/Cache-Control, four POSTs with exact status/whole-body/Content-Type covering init, positive transact, exact validation denial, and the same-batch cardinality-one batch, plus the terminal 401 unknown sse session teardown, and five ordered stream data frames compared whole-result under the masking rule: handshake, protocol-init attrs, transact-ok watermark exactly 2, exact 400 denial, cardinality transact-ok watermark exactly 3) replayed exactly by cmd/instantd/runtime_cf003_cardinality_replay_test.go::TestCF003CardinalityCaptureReplay on the owned isolated transactions-cardinality-boundary fixture (app 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003); convergence is proven live over the query path with exact whole-body bytes and whole-result DeepEqual lengths-before-elements (baseline, positive write, post-denial byte-identical proving the denial mutates nothing, cardinality final value winning exactly once), the seed admin transact runs live (tx-id watermark and X-admin-token never checked in), session/token/machine/attr values are never checked in (sentinel substitution/masking with live freshness, linkage, ordering, and no-leak asserts), and terminal quiescence plus dead-session teardown prove no unclaimed mutation. The WS legs of the transport matrix stay excluded by enforcement: no WS evidence is checked in and no WS claim is made. Merge/cascade/required legs remain unflipped as future work: no accepted assembled SSE-capturable leg proves deep-merge preservation convergence, cascade-delete convergence, or required-field denial over the single-subscriber SSE path (merge and delete exist only as live /admin/transact boundary evidence in the neighboring transactions-rollback-error replay; required retraction is WS corpus evidence only and WS recording stays excluded by enforcement). FU-02 Option A report-only; no v1-parity claim.
